dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000qxhm](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000qxhm) Magnitude 5.6 earthquake at 65.208 depth occurred on Aug 01 2025 36 km SSE of Severo-Kuril’sk, Russia. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 50.3777 longitude 156.3387. It impacted 1723 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
